setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
n = 3000
k = rng.integers(0, 5, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 8, (5, 10))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 10)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(10)])
df['cat'] = [f'g{v}' for v in k]

steps.name: the live layout is fitted: every point is inside the map
assert: (() => { const xy = a.anchorXY, n = a.prepared.nAnchors, c = a.renderer.container; let out = 0; for (let i = 0; i < n; i += 7) { const p = a.renderer.projectWorld(xy[2*i], xy[2*i+1]); if (!p || p[0] < 0 || p[1] < 0 || p[0] > c.clientWidth || p[1] > c.clientHeight) out++; } return out === 0; })()
steps.report: (() => { const xy = a.anchorXY, n = a.prepared.nAnchors; let x0 = 1e9, x1 = -1e9; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const p = a.renderer.projectWorld(xy[2*i], xy[2*i+1]); x0 = Math.min(x0, p[0]); x1 = Math.max(x1, p[0]); } return { x0: Math.round(x0), x1: Math.round(x1) }; })()

steps.name: open annotate tab and run automatic clusters
steps.eval: document.querySelector('#tab-annotate').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); const s = document.querySelector('select[aria-label="Label by"]'); s.value = 'clusters'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }))

steps.name: open explore tab and enable colour by clusters
points are drawn in cluster colours (non-grey pixels appear)
steps.eval: const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise((r) => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.width; c.height = img.height; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = g.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let n = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) if (d[k] + d[k+1] + d[k+2] > 60) n++; window.__drawnPixels = n

steps.name: legend swatches match point colours (single source of truth for each cluster i)
steps.eval: const pal = a.clusterPalette; const codes = a.cluster?.codes; const colorsAll = a.colorsAll; const h2r = h => [parseInt(h.slice(1,3),16),parseInt(h.slice(3,5),16),parseInt(h.slice(5,7),16)]; const results = []; if (pal && codes && colorsAll) { for (let ci = 0; ci < (a.cluster?.k ?? 0); ci++) { const [pr,pg,pb] = h2r(pal[ci]); let pointMatch = false; for (let i = 0; i < codes.length; i++) { if (codes[i] === ci) { pointMatch = Math.abs(colorsAll[i*4]-pr)<2 && Math.abs(colorsAll[i*4+1]-pg)<2 && Math.abs(colorsAll[i*4+2]-pb)<2; break; } } const swatchColor = document.querySelectorAll('.legend .sw')[ci]?.style?.background ?? '?'; results.push({ ci, palette: pal[ci], pointMatch, swatch: swatchColor }); } } window.__colorConsistency = results
